description: The Allstate Corporation was incorporated under the laws of the State of Delaware on November 5, 1992, to serve as the holding company for Allstate Insurance Company, and is one of the largest publicly held personal lines insurers in the United States, conducting its business principally through Allstate Insurance Company and other subsidiaries. Its strategy is to increase market share in personal property-liability and broaden protection offerings, and its reportable segments are Allstate Protection, offering private passenger auto, homeowners, other personal lines and commercial insurance through exclusive agents, independent agents, contact centers and online under the Allstate, National General, Direct Auto and Answer Financial brands; Run-off Property-Liability; and Protection Services, providing consumer product protection plans, roadside assistance, automotive protection, identity protection and restoration, and mobility products.
